subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Kinematic Chains: Linking Links Together
description: Learn Kinematic Chains: Linking Links Together in one minute.

hook.text: Connect several links in a loop and you get a kinematic chain.

buildup.text: A chain is open if the links form a path. It's closed if they form a loop.

discovery.text: Fix one link of a closed chain and the rest become a mechanism.

twist.text: Fixing a different link of the same chain creates a completely new motion.

climax.text: Robot arms are open chains. Engine linkages are closed chains.

punchline.text: Same links, different fixed point, different machine.

quiz.question: What happens when you fix a different link of a kinematic chain?
options: You get a completely different type of motion from the same links
The chain becomes an open chain instead of closed
